svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 02 / GROWING SNAKE
svg.desc: 25,795 GitHub contributions across 171 active days, 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-17. A snake eats all 171 active dates in ascending contribution-count order. It grows once every 5 dates, from 4 to at most 16 segments. Brighter food marks the current count tier; later tiers remain dormant floor.
